current_action: Built a first comparable opportunity matrix from public evidence: (A) SaaS demo videos have published briefs from $10–$400 and premium specialist offers but strong proposal competition/portfolio barriers; (B) beauty UGC has a Spain-specific €50–€150 public brief with creator/profile constraints; (C) local restaurant UGC has commercial platform/guide presence but no verified Nexia buyer; (D) SME AI/workflow automation has macro adoption signals (Banco de España EBAE: nearly 20% of surveyed firms use AI, mostly experimentally; task automation remains limited) but no willingness-to-pay evidence for our prototype. Additional falsification signal: an Upwork productized-service page for lead-intake/CRM-pipeline automation lists tiers at $95, $175 and $325, with the $95 tier covering a simple form-to-CRM connection and 2-day delivery. This is a seller's advertised offer and pricing anchor, not proof of completed purchases, buyer conversion, or Nexia's ability to deliver. Unit-economics sensitivity model added: at hypothetical €89 with 2h delivery + 1h acquisition and €5 tools, contribution is €39/order and simplified after-tax estimate €29.25; at €149 with 3h delivery + 1h acquisition, €84 contribution and €63 after-tax; at €249 with 5h delivery + 1h acquisition, €154 contribution and €115.50 after-tax. Assumptions: labor €15/hour, tax proxy 25% applied to positive contribution, price treated as net of VAT. Excludes fixed overhead, actual taxes, refunds, failed delivery, support beyond assumed hours, and variation in acquisition. To reach €1,000/month on these assumptions would require 35, 16 or 9 orders respectively. These are scenario calculations only, not forecasts.
